decision.reason: [ev-d9673d74f883] is a pre-upgrade check. It only tells operators to make sure they are not using `v1alpha1` resources and to check by manual inspection. It does not say what happens if they skip it: whether `v1alpha1` stops being served, whether resources are rejected, or whether the upgrade fails. The proposal's own statement admits this. The section context has no other text, so the migration-required kind (mandatory work) is not supported. To decide, the release text would need to say what changes for `v1alpha1` resources in 0.16, for example that the API version is removed or no longer served.
